source: Bohemia Interactive's DayZ game scripts (DayZ-Script-Diff): the recipes pluginrecipesmanagerbase.c registers (scripts/4_world/classes/recipes) and the vehicle scripts (carscript.c, motorbikescript.c, boatscript.c, inherited classes). Vehicle names, fuel tanks and radiator capacity from the DayZ Wiki (dayz.fandom.com), read 2026-11-15. Ruined ingredients cannot be used unless a recipe says so. takes is in the item's own quantity units (ml for liquids); qty null means the script leaves the amount to the item's default or to chance.

vehicles.name: Olga 24
vehicles.notes: The car battery must hold enough charge to crank the engine. Fill the radiator with water: below half coolant the engine takes damage while running, and taking the radiator out drains it. 2 headlight bulbs.

vehicles.name: M1025 Humvee
vehicles.notes: The car battery must hold enough charge to crank the engine. Glow plug instead of a spark plug; no radiator to fill. 2 headlight bulbs. Automatic gearbox (wiki).

vehicles.name: M3S
vehicles.notes: The truck battery must hold enough charge to crank the engine. No spark plug or radiator needed. Two spare M3S wheels fit behind the cab (open the side plate first). 2 headlight bulbs. The wiki says it drives on 2 of the 4 dual wheels, 4 recommended.

vehicles.name: Enduro Bike
vehicles.notes: No battery needed. 1 headlight bulb. Name from the wiki's Enduro Bike page (same colours); not confirmed.

vehicles.name: Motorbike 02
vehicles.notes: No battery needed. 1 headlight bulb. No wiki page: the in-game name is not confirmed. Takes front, left and right shields.

vehicles.name: Rubber Boat
vehicles.notes: The spark plug sits in the outboard motor and cannot be taken out while the engine runs. No battery needed.
